title: init
summary: Configures a repository: writes _D-RAG\config.json with every project, so index needs no target or --db
intro: Writes one _D-RAG\config.json at the repository root, listing every .dproj below it with its Delphi version, and a .gitignore beside it. Every verb run inside the repository finds it by walking up from the current folder, so drag-lint index with no target indexes all projects and no --db is needed. Reach for it once per repository, before the first index. It needs no index and leaves a repository without a config.json working as before.
